title: Website build for a family dental practice

messages.content: Cardholder statement forwarded by issuing bank: We paid $1,800 for a website for our dental practice. We do not have a working website. Patients searching for us get an error page. The service was never properly provided.

transaction_info.transaction_subject: Patel Family Dental - 6-page website, design + build + launch

documents.title: Website proposal + terms (accepted)
documents.summary: Scope, hosting responsibility, handover and support terms.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: Design and build a 6-page website (Home, Services, Team, Insurance, New Patients, Contact) with online appointment request form, and launch it on Client's hosting account. Fee: $1,800.

sections.heading: Hosting and domain
sections.text: Hosting and the domain patelfamilydental.com are purchased by and registered to Client, billed to Client's own card. Client is responsible for keeping hosting and domain renewals current. Developer does not control Client's billing.

sections.heading: Handover
sections.text: At launch Developer provides a handover document with all logins. Client owns all accounts.

sections.heading: Support
sections.text: 30 days of post-launch support for bugs is included. After that, help is billed at $80/hour.

sections.heading: Jun 12 - Sofia to Greg: We're live
sections.text: Greg, patelfamilydental.com is live! Attached is your handover doc with the logins for your hosting account (HostPeak), the website editor and your domain. Everything is in your name.

sections.heading: Jun 13 - Greg to Sofia
sections.text: Looks fantastic. Our front desk already got two appointment requests through the form this morning. Thank you!

sections.heading: Jun 16 - Sofia to Greg
sections.text: So glad to hear it! Invoice AWS-2026-031 sent via PayPal. Your 30 days of support run until July 12.

documents.title: Handover document (sent Jun 12)
documents.summary: Account ownership details for hosting, domain and editor.

sections.heading: Hosting
sections.text: HostPeak account owner: Greg Patel, greg@patelfamilydental.com. Plan: Business, renews monthly. Payment method on file: Visa ending 4417 (Client's card).

sections.heading: Domain
sections.text: patelfamilydental.com registered to Greg Patel, auto-renew ON, expires May 2027.

sections.heading: If the site ever goes down
sections.text: First check that the HostPeak payment method is current; suspended hosting shows an "Account Suspended" page. Updating the card restores the site within minutes.

documents.title: Uptime monitor history: patelfamilydental.com
documents.summary: Availability checks and status changes for the site.

sections.heading: Up
sections.text: 2026-06-12 18:02 UTC - Site UP (HTTP 200). Continuously up for 112 days.

sections.heading: Status change
sections.text: 2026-10-02 04:00 UTC - Site DOWN. Response HTTP 503 with page title "Account Suspended - HostPeak". Body text: "This account has been suspended due to a billing issue. If you are the account owner, please log in to update your payment method."

sections.heading: Still down
sections.text: 2026-10-19 12:00 UTC - Site still returning "Account Suspended - HostPeak".

documents.title: Google reviews for Patel Family Dental (screenshots)
documents.summary: Patient reviews that mention the website.

sections.heading: Jul 21 review
sections.text: "Booked my cleaning through their new website in two minutes. Super easy." - 5 stars

sections.heading: Oct 9 review
sections.text: "Their website seems to be down? Had to call to book." - 4 stars. Owner reply from Greg Patel: "Sorry about that! Our web person seems to have taken the site down, we're sorting it out."

answer_key.note: Used only by scripts/eval.js to score the agent. Never sent to the model.
answer_key.real_complaint: The client's own hosting lapsed because the card on file failed, so the site was suspended. The client believes the freelancer took it down or never really delivered it. The website was delivered, accepted and worked for 112 days.
